text: Even though the Dodd-Frank Act's overall regulatory impact on the private fund industry was low, the compliance costs generated by the evolving regulatory environment carry many unexpected consequences with the potential to further reshape industry practices.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479

isBasedOn.name: The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2

abstract: Despite the low regulatory impact of the Dodd-Frank Act overall, this article indicates that compliance costs associated with the evolving regulatory environment for private fund advisers have many unexpected consequences that could have the potential to further shape industry practices.
